Water Seekers, Thornweavers and Hunters hold the camp east of the The Crossroads. The supply crates sit at its eastern end. Warriors: the Coffre en fer dérobé stands in the camp. Shamans: the quilboar drop the Goudron de feu. Kill Savannah Prowlers you pass for their claws. Careful: The chest stands next to a broken wagon, guarded by a pair of Razormanes, including hunters that can pull more quilboar into the fight.
Récupérez 1 × Barres d'acier forgé (Coffre en fer dérobé)
Récupérez 1 × Goudron de feu sur Sourcier Tranchecrin

Back east over the bridge and up the trail to Telf Joolam's shrine, as at 10. Telf Joolam makes Sapta de feu from the tar and pouch. Use it by the brazier next to him to reveal the Manifestation de feu mineure, kill it for the Braise rougeoyante, then place the ember in the brazier.
